verdict.rationale: The search page points users to 'browsing expiring domains, premium names', and the availability-check API returns per-result pricing, so premium names appear in search in some form. Nothing documents how premium pricing is labeled or shown in search results, or any aftermarket, marketplace or broker path for acquiring taken names. Missing for 10: explicit premium-pricing display in search results, an aftermarket/marketplace listing integration, a broker or backorder service for taken names, and independent corroboration.
